title: EXP Bottle Counter
description: This mod tracks the amount of xp bottles players use and render them next to their nametags
body:
### XP TRACKER


This mod tracks the amount of experience bottles people use and display them next to their nametags.

It can be usefull in PvP.

This mod is just like uku's totem counter but instead it counts the usage of exp bottles. 

You shouldnt really get banned on servers for this since this is a client sided mod and doesnt provide a huge unfair advantage.

Contact me if you have any questions in my discord

discord- @amadaoo
